name: The New Adventures of Winnie the Pooh
description: An American animated children's television series inspired by A. A. Milne's Winnie-the-Pooh stories.

videos.title: Winnie the Pooh and Christmas Too
videos.overview: Christopher Robin and his friends make a Christmas list, but Pooh forgets to ask for a present. He must get the letter back, and get it to Santa Claus by Christmas, which happens to be tomorrow.

videos.title: Boo to you too! Winnie the Pooh
videos.overview: Piglet faces his Halloween fears in order to be able to celebrate Halloween with Tigger, Eeyore, Gopher and, of course, his best friend Pooh Bear.

videos.title: A Winnie the Pooh Thanksgiving
videos.overview: It's Thanksgiving time in the Hundred Acre Wood and Winnie the Pooh and his friends bring food for the big dinner. Piglet brings 'haycorns,' Pooh brings honey, Owl brings biscuits, and Tigger brings ice cream. But things change when Rabbit informs them that Thanksgiving is a special time of year that should include special items, so Pooh and the gang set off to find those very items.

videos.title: Winnie the Pooh: A Valentine for You
videos.overview: When Christopher Robin is seen writing a Valentine note to a girl, Pooh and the gang fear that he has been bitten by a "smitten".

videos.title: Winnie the Pooh: Seasons Of Giving
videos.overview: Seasons of giving is a 1999 American direct-to-video Christmas animated musical film that included A Winnie the Pooh Thanksgiving, and the two episodes from The New Adventures of Winnie the Pooh ("Groundpiglet Day" and "Find Her, Keep Her") (these episodes take place during the first two seasons). It features a new song by the Sherman Brothers. Seasons of Giving was released by Buena Vista Home Entertainment on November 9, 1999.

videos.title: Winnie the Pooh: A Very Merry Pooh Year
videos.overview: On Christmas Eve, Winnie the Pooh is having trouble setting up his Christmas tree. Pooh slips and falls, and breaks a shelf holding a present he made for Piglet. When Piglet suddenly arrives, Pooh desperately searches for a new hiding place for the present (since the broken shelf can no longer stay up) as more of his friends arrive at the door, eventually hiding it in an empty honey pot before helping himself to a full pot of honey, but forgets to answer the door. Afterward, his friends, tired of waiting for Pooh to answer, invite themselves in and proceed to help decorate his house. At one point, Tigger annoys Rabbit with some jingle bells. After they settle down to tell stories, Rabbit tells how they almost missed out on getting gifts one year, re-telling the story of Winnie the Pooh and Christmas Too. Afterward, Pooh appears dressed as Santa and exchanges gifts with everyone.

videos.title: Pooh Oughta Be in Pictures
videos.overview: As a reward for Christopher Robin eating all his vegetables, he along with Pooh, Piglet, and Tigger go to the theater to watch Birdzilla, a scary monster movie. During the film, Piglet gets scared and thinks the movie is real and the monster will get him. The gang tries to convince him that it is only make-believe and proceed to make their own monster film to prove it.

videos.title: Friend in Deed
videos.overview: Pooh has been borrowing too much honey from Rabbit lately. This makes Rabbit mad to the point where he says that Pooh is "eating him out of house and honey". Desperate, Pooh and his friends try to retrieve honey from a beehive, so Rabbit will not have to move away. Nevertheless, this proves to be a daunting task.

videos.title: Donkey For a Day
videos.overview: Piglet, feeling sorry for Eeyore, who always seems to be depressed, convinces the others to spend a whole day trying to cheer him up.

videos.title: There's No Camp Like Home
videos.overview: When the gang goes camping, Piglet is frightened by Tigger's stories and comes up against one of his greatest fears: Heffalumps.

videos.title: Balloonatics
videos.overview: Pooh borrows a balloon from Christopher Robin and the gang all panics when Rabbit causes it to become deflated.

videos.title: Find Her, Keep Her
videos.overview: Rabbit rescues a little bird named Kessie and finds himself in the role of parent. His overly-protective tendencies cause trouble when Kessie begins to feel an urge to fly, which Rabbit expressly forbids for fear of losing her.

videos.title: The Piglet Who Would Be King
videos.overview: Piglet sets out with Tigger and Rabbit to the Land of Milk and Honey, hoping to get some honey for Pooh as a gift after Piglet gets an unexpected gift from Pooh. They discover a tiny race of Piglet lookalikes called "Piglies" who elect Piglet their king, which causes him internal conflict--especially when Tigger and Rabbit abuse the Piglies' hospitality.

videos.title: Cleanliness Is Next to Impossible
videos.overview: Tigger encourages Christopher Robin to clean his messy room by throwing everything he owns under the bed. This proves troublesome when the gang discovers that the evil Crud and his sneezing minion, Smudge occupy a land beneath the mattress and plan to spread messiness everywhere.

videos.title: The Great Hunny Pot Robbery
videos.overview: All the honey in the Hundred-Acre Wood has disappeared and it appears to be the work of a Heffalump and a Woozle named Heff and Stan. When the gang successfully recovers the honey, Stan decides to get backup in the form of a giant Woozle named Wooster--but Pooh's offer of friendship provides a surprising resolution to the conflict.

videos.title: Stripes
videos.overview: When Rabbit forces Tigger to have a bath, the bounce-happy tiger's stripes come off. The gang believes that this "new" creature isn't Tigger, as all Tiggers have stripes, prompting an identity crisis in the sad tiger. Eventually, Eeyore solves the problem by pointing out that it is Tigger's heart, not his stripes, that make him who he truly is.

videos.title: Monkey See, Monkey Do Better
videos.overview: The gang meets a wind-up monkey toy named Bruno, who claims to be the "best toy a kid could get," in Christopher Robin's closet. Bruno boasts that he is better than all of Christopher's old toys, making them fear that they will be replaced.

videos.title: Babysitter Blues
videos.overview: Christopher Robin and the gang get into mischief while a babysitter tries to look after them.

videos.title: How Much Is That Rabbit in the Window?
videos.overview: After a calendar mishap leads Rabbit to believe that his birthday has been forgotten, he decides to run away from the Hundred-Acre-Wood, only to found by a secondhand shop owner who puts him up for sale. While the gang tries to find Rabbit, the bunny himself must fend off some thuggish toys who are out to make trouble.

videos.title: Gone with the Wind
videos.overview: After being buffeted about by the wind, Piglet becomes afraid of going outside.

videos.title: Nothing But the Tooth
videos.overview: Pooh believes he can no longer enjoy honey when he loses his "sweet tooth," which has been stolen by pack rats.

videos.title: Paw and Order
videos.overview: Pooh and the gang pretend to be in the Wild West during a play.

videos.title: Honey for a Bunny
videos.overview: When Rabbit throws away a lone bunny-shaped bookend, it finds its way all around the gang.

videos.title: Trap as Trap Can
videos.overview: Pooh and Piglet help a young heffalump who is having difficulty learning trapping from his father.

videos.title: The Masked Offender
videos.overview: Tigger takes on the identity of "The Masked Offender" in order to help people, but causes more trouble than he fixes.

videos.title: Things That Go Piglet in the Night
videos.overview: The gang is in a state of panic because they think they are being haunted by a ghost which was just Piglet running scared silly.

videos.title: Luck Amok
videos.overview: When Tigger breaks a mirror Rabbit was using, Rabbit believes he has bad luck, and so do the others, but it turns out Tigger has the bad luck.

videos.title: Magic Earmuffs
videos.overview: Christopher Robin gives Piglet "magic earmuffs" to help give him confidence in his ice skating. After losing the earmuffs, Piglet has a crisis of belief, only to discover his own skill when he must save the gang from the perils of an icy river.

videos.title: The Wishing Bear
videos.overview: When Christopher Robin shows Pooh a wishing star, Pooh tells Piglet, Tigger and Rabbit about it, and they all wish for something. But, when Pooh thinks he wished out the wishing star, and that the others' wishes will not come true, he tries his best to fulfill them all.

videos.title: King of the Beasties
videos.overview: Tigger thinks his great uncle is a lion and declares himself, "King of the Beasties" with chaotic results.

videos.title: The Rats Who Came to Dinner
videos.overview: Pooh and the gang try to deal with the pack rats during a flood.

videos.title: My Hero
videos.overview: Piglet saves Tigger's life, and Tigger becomes Piglet's servant.

videos.title: Owl Feathers
videos.overview: When the gang finds a pile of feathers on the trail, they believe that they belonged to Owl and that he has gone bald.

videos.title: A Very, Very Large Animal
videos.overview: Piglet thinks he is too small and moves away from the Hundred Acre Wood.

videos.title: Fish Out of Water
videos.overview: Rabbit is at his wit's end when Gopher is forced to move in with him.

videos.title: Tigger's Shoes
videos.overview: Rabbit gives Tigger weighted shoes and challenges him to jump the highest rock in the wood to keep him out of the way.

videos.title: Lights Out
videos.overview: When Rabbit takes Gopher's flashlight without asking, Gopher panics and he and the rest of the gang go in search of it.

videos.title: The 'New' Eeyore
videos.overview: Eeyore dresses up like Tigger in order to become more popular.

videos.title: Tigger, Private Ear
videos.overview: When Owl reads a thrilling mystery novel to the gang, Tigger inadvertently helps him find his lost glasses, prompting the bird to declare Tigger a detective. The bouncy tiger likes the idea, but resorts to committing crimes in secret to give himself cases to solve, which leads to attack of conscience when Pooh is accused of stealing honey.

videos.title: Party Poohper
videos.overview: Rabbit wants to plan a party for his five hundred visiting bunny relatives, and becomes obsessed with using a schedule to keep Pooh, Piglet, and Tigger on track. But when his excessive scheduling ends up driving everyone away by accident, he realizes that his desire for order has kept his family and friends from having fun.

videos.title: The Old SwitcheRoo
videos.overview: Roo asks Tigger to keep him from having a bath, and the tiger recruits Piglet to switch places with Roo to trick Kanga. But when Roo and Tigger get excessively dirty, and Kanga pretends that she does not recognize Piglet, everyone realizes that their attempted "switcheroo" has gone too far.

videos.title: Me and My Shadow
videos.overview: Piglet finds a shadow, and takes it home. His friends get somewhat jealous. That night the shadow leaves and Piglet goes to find him.

videos.title: To Catch a Hiccup
videos.overview: Piglet gets hiccups, so the gang helps Piglet to cure his hiccups

videos.title: Rabbit Marks the Spot
videos.overview: Sick of his friends ruining his garden while they are playing pirate, Rabbit gives them a fake treasure map "drawn from his great-great-great uncle and the greastest rabbit pirate ever, Long John Cottontail" that leads them to a chest full of rocks. When he becomes worried that his friends will hate him for deceiving them, he tries to get the chest back before they open it.

videos.title: Good-bye, Mr. Pooh
videos.overview: When Tigger spreads a rumor that Pooh is leaving the Hundred Acre Wood, everyone throws Pooh a good-bye party. Pooh then leaves and stays for a second, but when he gets home, he finds Eeyore living at his home.

videos.title: Bubble Trouble
videos.overview: Pooh gets stuck in a bubble, Gopher's hole blows away in a storm, and Rabbit hosts a vegetable meeting.

videos.title: Ground Piglet Day
videos.overview: It is Groundhog Day but there is no groundhog, so Rabbit makes Piglet the groundhog and he changes the holiday.

videos.title: All's Well That Ends Wishing Well
videos.overview: When the gang discovers that Tigger has never had a birthday, they decide to throw him a party that fails to impress him, especially when he does not get what he wants. A trip to the Hundred-Acre-Wood's wishing well leads Tigger to "Wishland," where everything he desires comes true. Eventually, though, he must choose between all of the possessions he has gained and his friends.

videos.title: Un-Valentine's Day
videos.overview: Rabbit makes a law that there will be no more Valentine's Day after everyone has received countless valentines in previous years.

videos.title: No Rabbit's a Fortress
videos.overview: Rabbit builds a fortress to prevent anyone from trampling into his garden only to realize that he has forgotten to put a door, thus trapping himself inside.

videos.title: The Monster FrankenPooh
videos.overview: It is a dark and stormy night in the Hundred Acre Wood and Tigger spins a tale of the mad scientist Piglet and his monster Frankenpooh.

videos.title: Where Oh Where Has My Piglet Gone?
videos.overview: Pooh thinks he has misplaced Piglet and tries to find him until he found him somewhere

videos.title: Up, Up And Awry
videos.overview: When Pooh tries to fly, the gang think that he is 'breaking the law' (of Gravity), so Pooh stays in his house all locked up

videos.title: Eeyore's Tail Tale
videos.overview: Eeyore becomes sick of his tail, so he abandons it. But Eeyore decides he wants it back, and Detective Tigger helps him. But the others find it and claim it as an object of their own.

videos.title: Three Little Piglets
videos.overview: Pooh tells the story of the three little pigs, Hundred Acre Wood style.

videos.title: Prize Piglet
videos.overview: Piglet and his friends run a race for a running trophy.

videos.title: Fast Friends
videos.overview: Piglet is stuck in the treehouse until he jumps off. Gopher tries to make Pooh faster so he won't be late as often.

videos.title: Pooh Moon
videos.overview: After Tigger tells the gang a scary story about "the Grab Me-Cotcha", they are alarmed to find that Pooh and Piglet are finding the honeymoon and comes home

videos.title: Caws And Effect
videos.overview: Piglet, Tigger and Rabbit go on a hunt to capture crows and leaves Pooh to watch Rabbit's garden. Unbeknownst to them the whole thing is a setup just to leave the garden under the protection of the "nitwit" Pooh.

videos.title: Oh, Bottle
videos.overview: When Pooh and Christopher Robin are playing pirates, Christopher Robin makes up a treasure map, and puts it in a bottle. He gives it to Pooh, but it gets stolen by the pack rats, so Pooh and the gang try to get it back to Christopher Robin.

videos.title: Owl In The Family
videos.overview: Owl wants to see his family, so Pooh and Piglet organise a family reunion for him. But does Rabbit think they're true?

videos.title: Sham Pooh
videos.overview: When Pooh loses his appetite, the others think he's not Winnie the Pooh, and then everybody thinks neither one of them are themselves. So, Detective Pooh and Tigger go look for Pooh's appetite.

videos.title: Rock-A-Bye Pooh Bear
videos.overview: Piglet has a bad dream about losing his friends in the storm and becomes afraid to go to sleep. All of his friends except him blow away. Will Piglet ever have a good dream?

videos.title: What's the Score, Pooh?
videos.overview: A game gets out of hand when Pooh accidentally touches Gopher's Big Boulder exhibition.

videos.title: Tigger's Houseguest
videos.overview: Tigger befriends a termite which had been eating all the wooden things in the Hundred Acre Wood. And Rabbit tells Tigger to get rid of the termite.

videos.title: Rabbit Takes A Holiday
videos.overview: Rabbit has no more work to do around his house and garden, so he leaves Pooh and the others to watch over. But while Rabbit is gone, Pooh and the others create utter chaos in his house and garden.

videos.title: Eeyi Eeyi Eeyore
videos.overview: Eeyore agrees to help Rabbit plant a seed near Eeyore's house. But Eeyore thinks that his seed will not grow, so Pooh and Tigger disguise Piglet as a flower and leave him near Eeyore's house overnight. When Rabbit thinks Eeyore is a better gardener than him because of the disguised Piglet, Rabbit gives up his property to Eeyore and lives in Eeyore's house. However, Eeyore is an inexperienced gardener and soon messes up Rabbit's garden.

videos.title: Pooh Skies
videos.overview: When Pooh knocks an eggshell out of tree, the gang becomes convinced that the sky is falling.

videos.title: To Bee Or Not To Bee
videos.overview: Christopher Robin and the gang are playing 'war' in their bedroom. His mother tells him to tidy up, so Pooh and his friends explain why they are playing 'war'.

videos.title: April Pooh
videos.overview: Pooh and his friends look for the April Fool, not aware that it is Christopher Robin playing jokes on them.

videos.title: A Knight To Remember
videos.overview: On a stormy night, Piglet enters a world where he is a brave Knight.

videos.title: Tigger Is the Mother of All Invention
videos.overview: Tigger's disastrous inventions bother his friends.

videos.title: The Bug Stops Hare
videos.overview: Pooh is babysitting Owl's nephew, Dexter, and Roo. They and the rest of the gang are invited to Christopher Robin's house so they could see his science project, which is an insect. But the gang accidentally lets the bug loose and soon agree that they will find a replacement bug for Christopher Robin.

videos.title: Easy Come, Easy Gopher
videos.overview: Rabbit becomes annoyed when Gopher starts digging his 'Ultimate Tunnel' around his house, so he re-writes the equation when Pooh accidentally messed it up, but that makes things worse.

videos.title: Invasion Of The Pooh Snatcher
videos.overview: When Tigger tells Piglet that Jagulars are roaming the wood, Piglet tells Pooh to help him protect his house, and Tigger thinks that Pooh has been snatched by a Jagular, and vice versa.

videos.title: Tigger Got Your Tongue?
videos.overview: Tigger loses his voice, and Pooh and the gang try to find the 'Nobody' that took it. Meanwhile, Gopher tries to get rid of the crows bothering him, and Rabbit tries to find his vegetables.

videos.title: A Bird In The Hand
videos.overview: When an adult Kessie returns to the Hundred-Acre Wood, Rabbit still treats her like a fledgling. When Kessie tries to prove that she is an adult, she runs away, but gets kidnapped by Stan and Heff, who demand honey for her release.

videos.title: Sorry, Wrong Slusher
videos.overview: Strange things happen when Christopher Robin and the gang watch a late night "Slusher" film.

videos.title: Grown, But Not Forgotten
videos.overview: When Christopher Robin has to attend a "grown up" girl's party, Pooh and the gang become afraid he, too, will grow up and will forget them.

videos.title: Pooh Day Afternoon
videos.overview: Christopher Robin, Pooh and the gang have to look after a dog.

videos.title: The Good, The Bad, And The Tigger
videos.overview: When Tigger loses control of Christopher Robin's toy train, he and Pooh are put on trial as train robbers.

videos.title: Home Is Where The Home Is
videos.overview: After Christopher Robin and the gang accidentally break a statue of his great-grandfather while cleaning up, Christopher runs away from home, with the gang offering their homes for him. When it turns out that he can not live in any of their houses, Pooh and the gang build him a home.

videos.title: Shovel, Shovel Toil And Trouble
videos.overview: When Gopher receives a large shovel, he goes overboard "improving" everyone's home.

videos.title: The Wise Have It
videos.overview: When the gang throw a birthday party for Pooh, they become convinced he is old and wise when they see how many candles there are on his cake. When they all ask Pooh for advice, things go awry.

videos.title: Cloud, Cloud Go Away
videos.overview: Tigger befriends a cloud that keeps crying. Pooh and his friends try to let Tigger do his bouncing lessons so the cloud responds to Tigger so it can be friendly.

videos.title: To Dream the Impossible Scheme
videos.overview: Gopher's Grandpappy comes for a visit, prompting Gopher to try to accomplish his Grandpappy's life-long dream of building an above-ground underground city.

videos.title: Piglet's Poohetry
videos.overview: Tigger causes trouble when he intrudes on Piglet's poetry.

videos.title: Owl's Well That Ends Well
videos.overview: Owl's poor singing upsets Rabbit, but scares off the crows.

country: United States, Japan, Australia, United Kingdom, Taiwan, South Korea, France, Philippines, Thailand, Canada
